info.name: Scheduled Mobility — Driver APIs
info.description: Import the matching local environment. Driver login → driver profile/documents → submit. A staff ADMIN must first register the driver (otherwise OTP login creates a PASSENGER). Use the separate admin login and admin folders for onboarding/review; refresh the driver token after role changes. Configure actual OTP codes; 0000 only works when OTP_FIXED_CODE=0000 and a fresh OTP was requested. Document uploads require manual file selection. Review state-changing admin requests individually; this collection is not a single linear Runner workflow. No real tokens or private keys are included.

request.description: Request a fresh OTP before verification. Local SMS stub writes the code to var/log/core-app.log. A fixed code still requires this step; resend cooldown is 60 seconds.
Set the actual OTP in the selected environment. Tokens are stored separately for driver and admin. Unknown phones become passengers; admin registration grants the DRIVER role.
On retry, set idempotencyKey to the exact key used in the original refresh. Clear it before a new operation.

**Roles:** ADMIN, SAFETY_OFFICER

item.name: Assign a vehicle for a period

request.description:
`validFrom` defaults to now and may be in the future; `validTo` is optional (open-ended). An open-ended assignment of the driver that started earlier ends at `validFrom`. A vehicle belongs to one driver at a time (`vehicle.already-assigned`); other overlaps for the driver are refused (`driver.assignment-overlap`).

**Roles:** ADMIN

Ends a current assignment now; cancels a future one.

**Roles:** ADMIN

Newest first; `q` matches the plate (separators ignored) or owner name. Rows include the driver the vehicle is assigned to right now.

**Roles:** ADMIN, DISPATCHER, SUPPORT, SAFETY_OFFICER

The plate is normalized (uppercase, single spaces) and must be unique (`vehicle.plate-taken`). `ownership` THIRD_PARTY (e.g. a rented tuk-tuk) requires `ownerName` and `ownerPhone`.

**Roles:** ADMIN
**Roles:** ADMIN, DISPATCHER, SUPPORT, SAFETY_OFFICER
